sections.heading: MAJOR IN MUSIC
lines: Don Wright Faculty of Music - Music Program - Bachelor of Arts
Completion of first year requirements, including Music 1649A/B, Music 1651A/B, Music 1710F/G and Music 1750F/G.
4.5 additional courses in Music at the 2000 level or above.

Note: A maximum of 1.0 course from Music 2700A/B, Music 2701A/B, Music 2702A/B, Music 2703A/B/Y, Music 2704A/B/Y, Music 2707A/B/Y, Music 2708A/B/Y, Music 2709A/B/Y, and Music 2801A/B may be counted toward the module.
